objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Send the XXL-JOB executor a job of your own, run a command on it and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The executor on 9999 accepts jobs from anyone: no accessToken is configured. Read XXL-JOB's executor API documentation.
One GLUE type runs its script in a shell on the executor host. The flag is at /ctf/flag on the executor machine.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which job scheduler, and which version, is deployed? (name and version)

steps.title: Find the target
steps.prompt: Which of the two components runs job scripts? (name)

steps.title: Find the missing setting
steps.prompt: Which configuration value, when empty, leaves the executor open to anyone? (setting name)

steps.title: Name the job type
steps.prompt: Which GLUE type runs a shell script? (type name)
